Monthly check:
• iPhone: Settings › [your name] › Subscriptions. Cancel anything you didn't use last month.
• Scan your card statement for small recurring charges.
• Note any free trials and their cancel-by dates.

A $9.99 charge you've forgotten is about $120 a year.
